answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fakes. Each work slot demands a 50 POA escrow deposit, and each agent must emit a regular pulse of real work. Five peers audit each slot in rotation; fake work burns the deposit, honest work returns it with the slot's fee. Honest agents gain a haven: one identity costs 50 POA and earns its fee back, but forging 1,000 slots locks 50,000 POA and burns it all, killing the fable that sybil farming is cheap.
